extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Text-layer PDF (2 pages = document pages 53-54). One horizontally tiled table: page 53 carries visits 1-8, page 54 ('(concluded)') reprints the same 30 body rows under visits 9-13, ET, RT; marks unioned. Two leading label columns (activity name col 1, VISIT/WEEK header-label col 2); first data column = 3. Grid verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning and raster rule-line detection; no disagreement. 'X' and 'P' are legend-defined in-grid marks kept as cell_value and also listed in annotation_markers so the legends bind.

table_metadata.notes: Page 54 is titled 'Schedule of Events for Protocol H2Q-MC-LZZT(c) (concluded)' and reprints the same activity rows under a different column block (visits 9-RT): a horizontally tiled table, extracted as one table with marks unioned, not a continuation. Activity label 'Hemoglobin A1C' on p53 prints as 'Hemoglobin A1c' on p54; p53 spelling used.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Visit identifiers printed in the header-label column as 'VISIT': 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (blank), 7, 8 on document page 53 and 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, ET, RT on page 54. Numbered/named visits -> visit. The column between visit 5 and visit 7 has an empty visit cell (no visit 6 printed).
Study week of each visit printed as 'WEEK': -2, -.3, 0, 2, 4, (blank), 6, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 26; empty for ET and RT (unscheduled Early Termination / Retrieval visits). Week numbers -> week.

annotations.annotation_text: Performed at this visit if patient is an insulin-dependent diabetic.
Performed at this visit and via telephone interview 2 weeks following this visit.

Practice only - It is recommended that a sampling of the CIBIC+, ADAS-Cog, DAD, and NPI-X be administered at Visit 1. Data from this sampling would not be considered as study data and would not be collected.

review_items.call_made: 'Study drug record', 'Medications dispensed' and 'Medications returned' are printed as three lines inside ONE rule-bounded row cell with a single X per visit column (printed on the first line). Extracted as three activities, each carrying the same X at visits 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and ET (the cell's mark applies to every label in the cell).
review_items.alternative: Either (a) marks belong only to 'Study drug record' (the line the X is printed on) and 'Medications dispensed'/'Medications returned' carry no marks, or (b) the cell is a single activity 'Study drug record' whose extra lines are sub-items/descriptions rather than separate activities.

review_items.call_made: The physical column between Visit 5 (week 4) and Visit 7 (week 6) on page 53, which has empty VISIT and WEEK header cells and no marks in any row, is kept as data column 8 with empty values.
review_items.alternative: Drop the empty column entirely (treat it as a presentation artefact, e.g. a deleted Visit 6), renumbering nothing else; or label it as an implied Visit 6 (not printed in the source).

review_items.call_made: Abbreviations ET (Early Termination) and RT (Retrieval) are kept as abbreviation annotations bound to the VISIT header cells that consist of exactly those terms (columns 16 and 17); CT and ECG from the same abbreviation line are dropped because they only occur inside activity labels.
review_items.alternative: Drop ET/RT as well (treat the whole abbreviation line as a standalone list with no in-grid marker), or keep CT/ECG bound to the 'CT Scan', 'ECG' and 'Ambulatory ECG' activity labels.
